A preliminary exploration of light-adapted chlorophyll fluorescence and stomatal conductance, and dark-adapted chlorophyll fluorescence from the Douglas fir seedlings in our IFG stress priming experiment.

To do:
- account for upward drift of PhiPS2, then make some plots and do some stats
- Look at gsw data -- and see if you can make sense of it even if the needles didn't always fill the chamber completely

```{r load packages and data, results = 'hide', message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
source("read_LI-600.R")

# NOTE: IFG instrument was not adjusted for daylight savings time, so time stamps are one hour too early.

doug_path1 = "../data/241104 Pseudosuga dark adapted FvFm Bogar instrument/2024-11-04/Bogar FvFm 600N_LMB_2024_11_04_16_24_47_1.csv"
doug_path2 = "../data/241104 Pseudotsuga Bogar FvFm 600N IFG instrument/2024-11-04/Bogar FvFm 600N_LMB_2024_11_04_15_41_19_1.csv"
doug_path3 = "../data/241104 Pseudotsuga Bogar light Bogar instrument/2024-11-04/Bogar light N_LB_2024_11_04_13_27_41_1.csv"
doug_path4 = "../data/241104 Pseudotsuga Bogar light Bogar instrument/2024-11-04/Bogar light N_LB_2024_11_04_14_04_25_1.csv"
doug_path5 = "../data/241104 Pseudotsuga Bogar light IFG instrument/2024-11-04/Bogar light N_LB_2024_11_04_14_12_02_1.csv"
treatments = read_csv("240910_all_plants_and_treatments.csv")

```
```{r cleaning up data, results = 'hide', message=FALSE}
doug1 = read_li600_data(doug_path1)
doug2 = read_li600_data(doug_path2)
doug3 = read_li600_data(doug_path3)
doug4 = read_li600_data(doug_path4)
doug5 = read_li600_data(doug_path5)

# Fixing time stamp issues
doug1$posix_time = as.POSIXct(doug1$Time, format = "%H:%M:%S")

doug2$posix_time = as.POSIXct(doug2$Time, format = "%H:%M:%S")
doug2_timecorrected = doug2 %>% mutate(posix_time = posix_time + (60*60))

doug3$posix_time = as.POSIXct(doug3$Time, format = "%H:%M:%S")

doug4$posix_time = as.POSIXct(doug4$Time, format = "%H:%M:%S")

doug5$posix_time = as.POSIXct(doug5$Time, format = "%H:%M:%S")
doug5_timecorrected = doug5 %>% mutate(posix_time = posix_time + (60*60))

treatments$plantID = str_pad(treatments$Plant, width = 3, pad = "0")
treatments$ABA = fct_recode(treatments$Tape_color, 
                            "3 wks" = "O", 
                            "2 wks" = "Y",
                            "0 wks" = "G", 
                            "None" = "B") %>%
  fct_relevel("0 wks", after = Inf)

treatments$soil = fct_recode(treatments$Soil, 
                            "Douglas fir - live" = "DE",
                            "Douglas fir - sterilized" = "DFS",
                            "Poplar - live" = "PE",
                            "Poplar - sterilized" = "PS")

# Making dark data frame
dougdark = full_join(doug1, doug2_timecorrected)

dougdark$plantID = dougdark$`Plant number`

dougdark_with_tx = left_join(dougdark, treatments)

# dougdark_with_tx$posix_time = as.POSIXct(dougdark_with_tx$Time, format = "%H:%M:%S")

dougdark_with_tx_noflag = subset(dougdark_with_tx, is.na(remark))

# Making light data frame
douglight = full_join(doug3, doug4)
douglight = full_join(douglight, doug5_timecorrected)
douglight$plantID = douglight$`Plant number`

douglight_with_tx = left_join(douglight, treatments)

douglight_with_tx_noflag = subset(douglight_with_tx, is.na(remark))

```

How did Fv/Fm look through time?

```{r Checking FvFm, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(dougdark_with_tx_noflag, aes(x = posix_time, y = `Fv/Fm`)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y~x)
```

```{r Dark adapted fluorescence, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
doug_summ_FvFm = dougdark_with_tx_noflag %>% group_by(plantID, Species, soil, ABA) %>%
  summarize(mean_FvFm = mean(`Fv/Fm`), num_obs = n()) %>% subset(!is.na(ABA))
# There's one NA in the ABA treatments,
# let's look up what plant that is later.

ggplot(doug_summ_FvFm, aes(x = soil, y = mean_FvFm, fill = ABA)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(x = "Soil treatment",
       y = "Pseudotsuga Fv/Fm just prior to harvest") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r ANOVA for Fv/Fm}
FvFm_doug = lm(as.numeric(`Fv/Fm`) ~ soil * ABA, data = dougdark_with_tx_noflag)
FvFm_doug_anova = aov(FvFm_doug)
summary(FvFm_doug_anova) # only soil mattered for doug firs
TukeyHSD(FvFm_doug_anova) # specifically, Doug fir live did better than any other soil (p < 0.05), especially compared to Poplar live and poplar sterilized (p<<0.01).

```


How about PhiPS2?

```{r Checking PhiPS2, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(douglight_with_tx_noflag, aes(x = posix_time, y = PhiPS2)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y~x)
```

Upward through the day, as happened last time. Many low  values here.
